remarks:
NEW on the market... Secluded almost 13-Acre Campground & Recreational Property with a Creek, log cabin and more! Calling all outdoor enthusiasts, nature lovers, and those seeking a private retreat! This unique almost 13-acre property in the Town of Dunkirk offers a rare combination of privacy, recreational opportunity, and convenience.

The property is currently set up as a private campground and features several camper trailers, multiple outbuildings, a charming small log cabin, and a creek running through the property. The existing campers and buildings will remain with the sale. Some may require repairs or updates, while others are in good condition and ready to use.

For those looking to enjoy an off-grid lifestyle, the property offers plenty of space and natural surroundings to create your own secluded getaway. If traditional utilities are preferred, water and electric are available at the street, providing options for future development.

The property also includes a gas well, offering the potential for access to natural gas at no cost to the owner, subject to applicable regulations and installation requirements. A septic system would be needed for residential development.

Continue using the property as a private campground and weekend retreat, or explore the possibility of building your dream home surrounded by nature. Despite its secluded setting, the property is conveniently located in the town of Dunkirk, providing easy access to food, entertainment, Lake Erie beaches, and other everyday amenities.

Whether you're searching for a recreational property, private camping retreat, investment opportunity, or a future homesite, this one-of-a-kind property offers space, privacy, natural beauty, and endless possibilities. Sold as is.
